anchor_value: USD-denominated amortized cost column in source schedule

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Monitorus Holding delayed draw term loan shows EUR only in the Principal Amount/Shares column, while Amortized Cost is 3,619,086 and Fair Value is 3,460,339 under the dollar-denominated cost/value columns.
Par amount is denominated in U.S. Dollars unless otherwise noted Euro.

rationale: FX03 flagged cost_currency as non-USD, but the source schedule presents amortized cost and fair value as dollar-denominated columns. The only explicit Euro marker in the relevant SOI appears in the principal amount/share column for Monitorus, and the footnote says par amount is USD unless otherwise noted Euro. That supports a foreign principal denomination, not a non-USD cost valuation field.
